title: Return and Refund Policy
content: Products may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unused, in original packaging, and accompanied by proof of purchase. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after receiving the return. Shipping costs for returns are covered by the customer unless the return is due to a defective product or shipping error. Gift cards and downloadable software are non-refundable.

title: Shipping Policy
content: We offer free standard shipping on orders over $50 within the continental US. Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days, express shipping takes 2-3 business days ($12.99), and overnight shipping is available ($24.99). International shipping rates vary by destination. Orders are processed within 1 business day. Tracking information is provided via email once the order ships.

title: Warranty Policy
content: All products include a standard 1-year manufacturer warranty covering defects in materials and workmanship. Extended warranty options are available: 2-year ($49.99) and 3-year ($79.99). Warranty does not cover physical damage, water damage, unauthorized modifications, or normal wear and tear. To file a warranty claim, contact support with your order number and description of the issue.

title: Privacy Policy
content: We collect personal information necessary to process orders and improve our services. This includes name, email, shipping address, and payment information. We do not sell personal data to third parties. Data is encrypted using industry-standard SSL encryption. Customers can request data deletion by contacting our privacy team at privacy@techpro.com.

title: Price Match Policy
content: We guarantee the best price on all our products. If you find an identical item at a lower price from an authorized retailer within 14 days of purchase, we will match that price and refund the difference. The competing price must be currently available and verifiable. Exclusions apply to marketplace sellers, auction sites, and clearance items. Contact support with proof of the lower price to initiate a price match claim.
